polityNote: Republic of Zimbabwe from independence on 1980-04-18. Atoms: geoBoundaries ZWE ADM2 (ZIMSTAT/OCHA 2020, 91 districts, CC BY 3.0 IGO). A province is the union of its districts as ZIMSTAT assigns them (gb ADM1 of the same publisher nests exactly). Ruwa is in Mashonaland East (ZIMSTAT; the 2022 Harare Province population excludes it); Harare Province = Harare, Harare Rural, Chitungwiza, Epworth. Rewritten from ne-admin1 to gb-adm2 (2026-10-06) because the 1982-1997 provinces are unions of districts that NE cannot split. (1) Independent check against Müller-Crepon’s CC0 regions panel (DVN/BM4WW0): in 1990 every district falls >=0.96 inside the panel region this dossier gives it; in 2000 likewise except the panel’s coarse Harare/Bulawayo outlines (0.80-0.93). Manicaland: union 35,954 km² vs 1969 table 35,775 (+0.5%).
